required_semantic_inputs.name: collision_event_domain
required_semantic_inputs.purpose: enumerate the physical collision events generated by the response and deletion trace

required_semantic_inputs.name: physical_offspring_constructor
required_semantic_inputs.purpose: map each collision event to an exact physical offspring object

required_semantic_inputs.name: collision_multiplicity_rule
required_semantic_inputs.purpose: assign exact multiplicity to each physical offspring without alias projection

required_semantic_inputs.name: owner_fate_collision_key_constructor
required_semantic_inputs.purpose: construct complete owner/fate/collision child keys for every offspring

required_semantic_inputs.name: interface_provenance_constructor
required_semantic_inputs.purpose: attach exact interface and provenance labels to every offspring key

required_semantic_inputs.name: global_transition_occurrence_witness
required_semantic_inputs.purpose: prove the sample transition occurs in the installed recurrent system

non_derivations: deleted-edge count is not a collision coefficient
blocker membership is not a physical offspring enumeration
return multiplicity is not collision multiplicity
operation-kind registration is not a transition-instance witness
missing collision semantics do not imply coefficient zero
